description: This file defines the FunctionResolution class responsible for resolving functions within Spark SQL's catalyst analysis phase, including handling built-in, temporary, and user-defined functions, as well as validating function arguments and syntax.

classes.name: FunctionResolution
classes.description: Class responsible for resolving and validating functions in Spark SQL, supporting built-in, temporary, and user-defined functions, with detailed argument and syntax validation.

methods.name: resolveFunction
methods.description: Resolves an unresolved function to an expression, handling built-in, temporary, and catalog functions.

methods.name: hasLambdaAndResolvedArguments
methods.description: Checks if a sequence of expressions contains lambdas and if all other expressions are resolved.

methods.name: lookupBuiltinOrTempFunction
methods.description: Looks up a built-in or temporary function by name and optional unresolved function context.

methods.name: lookupBuiltinOrTempTableFunction
methods.description: Looks up a built-in or temporary table function by name.

methods.name: resolveBuiltinOrTempFunction
methods.description: Resolves a built-in or temporary function with given arguments, validating the function.

methods.name: resolveBuiltinOrTempTableFunction
methods.description: Resolves a built-in or temporary table function with given arguments.

methods.name: validateFunction
methods.description: Validates a function expression against various constraints and syntax rules.

methods.name: checkUnsupportedAggregateClause
methods.description: Checks if an aggregate clause has unsupported features like DISTINCT, FILTER, or IGNORE NULLS.

methods.name: resolveV2Function
methods.description: Resolves a V2 unbound function by binding input types and matching to scalar or aggregate functions.

methods.name: processV2ScalarFunction
methods.description: Processes a V2 scalar function, validating syntax features like DISTINCT, FILTER, and IGNORE NULLS.

methods.name: processV2AggregateFunction
methods.description: Processes a V2 aggregate function, converting it into an aggregate expression.

methods.name: failAnalysis
methods.description: Throws an AnalysisException with specified error class and message parameters.
